Name: Cleaner Farm Buildings
Author: c0rvoid
Description:
This mod removes the messy floors and walls of Coops, Barns, and the Cellar, and optionally removes decorations such as barrels, columns, and hay. The building style used can be changed using Generic Mod Config Menu.

Configuration is as follows:
﻿Cellar 1: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed
﻿Cellar 2: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed; barrels and logs removed
﻿Cellar 3: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed; barrels, logs, columns, and sconces removed

﻿Coop 1: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed
﻿Coop 2: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed; hay on the floor removed

﻿Barn 1: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed
﻿Barn 2: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed; barrels, logs, and hay on the floor removed
﻿Barn 3: Cracks in the floor and walls fixed; barrels, logs, and hay on the floor removed; removed popout in left wall

This mod was somewhat inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2975]Clean Cellar[/url]﻿.
